items.claim: Derivation memo kept the old value after a re-derive threw

items.note: This also covers two more spots: `outerOps.causing` now tests the bound op, so the op applies against the adapter, and `recorder.join` records the ops a joined op says it caused.

items.claim: `RebasedDep` had no `children`, so nested groups dropped out of a boolean group
An edit pass counted ops that changed nothing as applied, which stopped coalescing
`kit:removeLayer` and `kit:addLayer`'s revert spliced by the recorded index, not by id
`pathFromParts` joined parts under `nonzero`, filling an `evenodd` part's holes
items.note: A set holding an `evenodd` part is now unioned. A set where every part is `nonzero` keeps the cheaper join.

items.claim: A child that left and came back in one edit was reported as an arrival
`kit:addLayer` applied over a layer id the scene already holds
Layer `parallax` options were stored by reference and never owned
items.note: They now pass through `own()`, so in development a write into them throws, as it does for a pose. The changeset tells consumers to pass a new object for each change. The only in-repo caller, `ParallaxDemo`, already builds fresh objects.
